rules.title: No custom jev/ LSP methods
rules.text: N6: no custom `jev/…` LSP methods — the standard surface plus `workspace/executeCommand` is the whole back-channel (PROTOCOL.md §1).

judgement.question: Is this a custom `jev/…` LSP method — a name the server answers, advertises or registers as a protocol method — rather than a standard `…/…` method or a command served through `workspace/executeCommand`?

criteria.true: the name is a `jev/…` method served on the wire as a method: a registration call, an entry in the served-method list, a match arm or handler dispatching on it, or an advertisement
criteria.false: it is a `workspace/executeCommand` command spelled with a dot (`jev.x`), a standard `…/…` method, a doc comment, or a fixture that names one without serving it
